title: Zoom every way
text: Wheel, pinch, buttons, and + / - keys, around the pointer; fit and actual size with 0 and 1.

title: Pan and rotate
text: Drag or arrow keys to pan a zoomed image; R rotates in 90 degree steps.

title: Gallery or lightbox
text: Inline viewer or a modal lightbox that restores focus, with a thumbnail strip and "2 of 5".

title: Crop to a Blob
text: Aspect ratio presets, a crop area you move and resize by pointer or keyboard, and a canvas plus Blob out.

title: Safe by default
text: Alt text required; only https, blob, raster data, and same-origin image URLs; CSP-safe transforms.
